answer: Each epoch, a seat stays live only if its holder passes a skill test drawn from 12 rotating task types; an attempt takes 30 minutes of compute, and scoring below 60% suspends the seat for 2 epochs. A farm running 1,000 fakes must spend 500 compute-hours per epoch, while one agent spends half an hour. Each pass is stamped on an onyx ledger at its vertex, so passes piling onto one vertex from one knoll flag the cluster.
